headline: Danïel Salazar and Hmm climb to 31st and 32nd

sections.text: Danïel Salazar gained 6.84 points to reach 34.73, jumping from 868th to 31st. Hmm climbed from 688th to 32nd with a gain of 5.93, reaching 34.61.
The two teams now sit side by side just outside the board’s gold places, which extend through 18th. Their gains add fresh depth to the chase behind the medal group.
